neighbours.label: A comparative or superlative of age, size or shade standing in the determiner slot as the head (our oldest, my youngest, the larger, one darker)
fire: Both girls play piano, but my eldest also sings in the choir.
Of the two puppies, the smaller was much braver.
Paint the sky in two blues, one lighter near the horizon.
We have four children; our youngest is still in diapers.
The twins look alike, though the older is a bit taller.
Pick two boxes and put the heavier on the bottom.
Of all my cousins, the oldest moved abroad first.
My older has just started learning to drive.
quiet: Both girls play piano, but my niece also sings in the choir.
Of the two puppies, the brown one was much braver.
Paint the sky in two blues, one near the horizon.
We have four children; our baby is still in diapers.
The twins look alike, though Sam is a bit taller.
Pick two boxes and put the red one on the bottom.
Of all my cousins, Maria moved abroad first.
My brother has just started learning to drive.
